biggest_catch: The friend MUST open their account with the same email address that received the invitation - use a different email and the referral can't be credited or fixed.
catches: Referring member receives $100 per friend who opens a first Union Square checking account and completes the requirements; the friend also gets $100.

Friend must: open a first Kasasa Cash or Kasasa Cash Back checking (no checking account in the past 24 months), make 5+ debit card purchases within 60 days, log into online banking at least once within 60 days, and keep the account open and in good standing for 60 days.
Five paid referrals per qualifying member, up to $500; no limit on invitations.
Referrer must be 18+; referred member must be within Union Square's field of membership (7 TX/OK counties + Red Cross/TCC groups).
Both bonuses deposited within 15 days of the friend completing the qualifications and the account being open at least 60 days.
Bonus may be reported as taxable income; employees, volunteers, and officials are not eligible.

steps: Fill out the Union Square Refer a Friend form with your info and your friend's name and email.
Friend opens a first Kasasa Cash or Kasasa Cash Back checking account using the same email that received the invitation.
Friend makes 5+ debit card purchases and logs into online banking within 60 days, keeping the account in good standing for 60 days.
You receive $100 within 15 days (up to 5 referrals, $500).
timing: Bonuses deposited within 15 days of the friend completing qualifications and the account being open at least 60 days.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Bonuses deposited within 15 days of the friend completing qualifications and the account being open at least 60 days. — the friend's qualification window runs up to 60 days and the payout clock starts only after.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
